why_it_passes: It starts from a status (a release is broken) but asks a real choice only an owner can make, with what each choice costs.

card.title: Pull back today's release?
card.context: Today's release broke printing for about a third of clinics: the print button does nothing. A fix is two days away. We can pull the release back now, which also removes the new invoice screen clinics asked for, or keep it and tell those clinics to print from the browser menu until the fix.
card.question: Should we pull back today's release until printing is fixed?

choices.label: Pull it back now
choices.pros: printing works again within the hour
choices.cons: clinics lose the new invoice screen for two days

choices.label: Keep it and send the workaround
choices.cons: a third of clinics print the slow way for two days, and some will call support

card.why: Printing is used all day; the new screen can wait two days.

rulings.name: merge-after-green
rulings.text: An agent merges its own pull request once a separate review agent has signed off and the required checks are green. The owners never review or merge pull requests themselves.

rulings.name: no-weekend-deploys
rulings.text: Nothing is released to customers between Friday 6 pm and Monday 8 am, whoever asks.
